glossary.definition: As used in this section, "certified copy" means a copy containing a written statement attesting that it is a true and exact reproduction of the original proposed ordinance or measure or of the original ordinance or measure.
glossary.source_title: Section 731.32 - Copy of proposed ordinance or measure filed with auditor or clerk.
